items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Snuya' only in the context of correcting a word in Flemish ('The tree bomb. Not bomb, bomb.') and referencing a school experience ('He went to school in Flemish, too, you know.'), but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with a person named Snuya.

ctx.x: [Snuya?] [speaks in Flemish] [unintelligible] [snuya?]. The tree bomb. Not bomb, bomb.
